dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

colorConfigurationStrategy.description: The strategy used for determining the colors of the markers. Currently, only conditional (single threshold) coloring is supported.

title:
A specification that describes how to use a field of the dataType for determining the color of the markers
on a {@link UiSdlMap} instance.
name: UiSdlMapMarkerColorFieldSetting
